jobs.title: Associate Product Manager
jobs.description:
About Northern Trust

As a global leader in innovative wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services, Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS) is proud to guide the world’s most successful individuals, families, corporations and institutions.

Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. Together, they reflect the three cornerstones of business conduct which we strive to instill in our employees, whom we call partners, and to provide to our clients and the communities we serve worldwide.

With more than 135 years of financial experience and over 24,000 partners, we serve the world’s most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service.

Desired Skills & Qualifications
- Knowledge of Product Management principles, Agile methodologies, and the product development lifecycle.
- Ability to gather and analyze business requirements and translate them into clear user stories and acceptance criteria.
- Experience managing and prioritizing product backlogs in a fast-paced Agile environment.
- Strong analytical, problem-solving, and critical thinking skills.
- Excellent verbal, written, and presentation communication skills.
- Ability to collaborate effectively with business stakeholders, technology teams, and cross-functional partners.
- Customer-focused mindset with a passion for delivering valuable product outcomes.
- Experience supporting product delivery, testing, release readiness, and continuous improvement initiatives.
- Proficiency with Azure DevOps, Jira, or similar product management tools.
- Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.
- Bachelor's degree in Business, Technology, Finance, Engineering, or a related field preferred.

Preferred Qualifications
- Experience in financial services, wealth management, or digital product delivery.
- Familiarity with SAFe practices and Product Management frameworks.
- Experience leveraging AI tools such as Microsoft Copilot to improve productivity and product delivery.
- Strong Agile and Scrum methodology knowledge (SAFe)\
- Experience creating and refining User Stories
- Backlog management and prioritization skills
- Knowledge of product roadmaps and release planning
- Cross-functional collaboration with engineering, QA, and business teams
- Experience with JIRA/Azure DevOps
- Experience in executing Agile ceremonies- Standup, PI planning, Spring Planning, Sprint Demo etc.
- Requirements gathering and business analysis expertise
- Understanding of SDLC and Agile delivery metrics
- Facilitation of backlog refinement and sprint planning sessions

Working with Us

As a Northern Trust partner, you will be part of a flexible and collaborative work culture, which has a strong history of financial strength and stability. Movement within the organization is encouraged, senior leaders are accessible, and you can take pride in working for a company committed to an inclusive workplace and assisting the communities we serve.

Philanthropy is deeply rooted in Northern Trust’s history and is an essential element of our culture. Employees around the world give their time and talent to work for the greater good of their communities.

Reasonable Accommodation

Northern Trust is committed to working with and providing adjustments to individuals with health conditions and disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please email our HR Service Center at MyHRHelp@ntrs.com , or alternatively you can discuss your individual requirements with the recruiter you are working with.

About Our Pune Office

The Northern Trust Pune office, established in 2016, is now home to over 3,000 employees. The office handles various functions, including Operations for Asset Servicing and Wealth Management, as well as delivering critical technology solutions that support business operations across the globe.

Our Pune team takes our commitment to service to heart. In 2024, they volunteered more than 10,000+ hours into the communities where they live and work. Learn more.

The CoPilot Product Owner is responsible for delivering Personal AI enablement and product strategy in support of the Enterprise AI Program goals and objectives. - Maintain an enterprise-wide perspective to optimize efficiency, effectiveness, and productivity
- Perform risk analysis and maintain risk assessments aligned to governance frameworks and controls
- Track product KPIs (adoption, satisfaction, performance) and conduct post-launch audits to drive continuous improvement

- Support executive decision-making through structured insights and performance analytics
- Balance strategic direction with operational execution to deliver measurable business outcomes

- Comfortable operating a business enablement product for a technical product environment. on
- Understanding of Microsoft Copilot ecosystem (M365 Copilot, Copilot Studio, agents) including enterprise deployment, usage patterns, and productivity use cases
- Knowledge of AI-powered personal productivity workflows (workflow automation, knowledge grounding, prompts, agent orchestration, collaboration enablement)
- Familiarity with enterprise AI governance, risk, and compliance frameworks (e.g., data protection, access controls, model risk, audit requirements) as applied to Copilot and enterprise AI tools
- Experience with product lifecycle management, including roadmap development, launch execution, and post-launch optimization
- Strong understanding of usage telemetry, adoption metrics, and value realization frameworks (e.g., productivity KPIs, ROI modeling, OKRs tied to Copilot adoption)

- Experience working in regulated environments with audit, risk, and compliance alignment for AI-driven solutions

Excellent communication and problem-solving skills

jobs.title: Specialist Product Manager / Agile Product Owner
jobs.description:
About Northern Trust

As a global leader in innovative wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services, Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS) is proud to guide the world’s most successful individuals, families, corporations and institutions.

Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. Together, they reflect the three cornerstones of business conduct which we strive to instill in our employees, whom we call partners, and to provide to our clients and the communities we serve worldwide.

With more than 135 years of financial experience and over 24,000 partners, we serve the world’s most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service.

Job Profile Summary:
The Specialist Product Manager / Agile Product Owner is accountable for maximizing the business value delivered by an agile product delivery team. This role represents the voice of the business, client, and regulatory stakeholders, ensuring that product delivery aligns to strategic objectives, client outcomes, and enterprise priorities.
The Product Manager/Owner influences & translates product vision and business strategy into a prioritized and actionable product backlog, driving delivery outcomes through close partnership with Technology, Business Analysis, and cross-functional stakeholders.

Key Responsibilities of the Role Include:
1. Product Ownership & Value Delivery
- Own and prioritize the Product Backlog to optimize business value and client outcomes
- Ensure backlog alignment to product strategy, regulatory requirements, and funding commitments
- Make informed trade-off decisions across scope, timeline, risk, and investment
- Define and maintain clear acceptance criteria to ensure delivery meets intended outcomes
- Balance short-term delivery needs with long-term product evolution and sustainability
- Carry out complex initiatives involving multiple disciplines and/or ambiguous issues

2. Agile Execution & Delivery Oversight
- Actively participate in Agile ceremonies including sprint planning, reviews, and retrospectives
- Accept or reject completed work based on defined acceptance criteria and alignment to business intent
- Ensure delivery teams focus on outcomes, not just feature completion
- Partner with Scrum Masters and Technology Leads to maintain delivery momentum and remove blockers
- Ensure backlog items are clearly defined, sequenced, and ready for development
- Conduct post launch audits, track product success, analyze P&L, metrics, KPIs

3. Stakeholder & Business Engagement
- Serve as the primary liaison between business stakeholders and delivery teams
- Engage Product Executives, Operations, Risk, Compliance, and Technology partners to align priorities
- Communicate product vision, roadmap, and delivery progress to stakeholders in a clear, concise manner
- Represent client and business needs throughout the product lifecycle
- Provide sales support including presenting at client & prospect meetings
- Display a balanced, cross-functional perspective, liaising with the business to improve efficiency, effectiveness and productivity

4. Strategic Alignment & Product Direction
- Formulate strategy by aligning cross functional teams, uncovering opportunities and determining life cycle states.
- Shape the value proposition and develop business cases as part of the product roadmap planning process.
- Create strategies for cross-program coordination and go-to-market rollouts.
- Align backlog priorities to product roadmaps, enterprise initiatives, and client commitments
- Ensure solutions meet regulatory, operational, and risk management expectations
- Collaborate with Product Management to align delivery with broader product strategy
- Continuously refine product priorities based on stakeholder feedback, performance, and outcomes

5. Risk, Control & Regulatory Alignment
- Lead in introducing new products and features to the market by securing regulatory approvals, contributing to marketing materials and conducting sales and operational readiness training.
- Ensure delivered functionality aligns with regulatory obligations and audit requirements
- Incorporate risk, compliance, and data governance considerations into backlog prioritization
- Partner with Business Analysts to ensure requirements reflect controls, data rules, and quality standards

Skills/ Experience Required
- Seasoned multi-disciplinary expert with extensive technical and / or business knowledge and functional expertise
- Excellent oral and written communication skills are required. Proficient in constructing/overseeing logical and conclusive presentations, distilling complex subject matter into management-ready materials
- Thorough understanding or knowledge of all products or business areas within an umbrella roadmap, mastery of 2-4+ and SME ability in at least 1-2+ specific areas; and a strong understanding of client needs and how this impacts the product development agenda/roadmap
- Excellent in building key relationships, influencing and negotiating with clients, partners and leaders across multiple disciplines
- Program or project management experience is advantageous; planning, analysis, design and governance
- Strong knowledge of business strategy development is necessary to provide long term planning and to manage the profitability/performance of a major business segment.
- Leadership and organizational skills are required to determine the Business Unit's goals, resources needed, and to assess and develop the skills of staff.

Work Authorization

Applicants must have the right to work in Ireland at the time of application and for the duration of employment.

Please note that Northern Trust is unable to provide employment permit sponsorship for this role. This includes Critical Skills Employment Permits, General Employment Permits, Intra-Company Transfer Employment Permits, Stamp 1G permissions, and other employment permits under Irish immigration frameworks.

jobs.title: Senior Principal, IAM Strategy & Product Management
jobs.description:
About Northern Trust

As a global leader in innovative wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services, Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS) is proud to guide the world’s most successful individuals, families, corporations and institutions.

Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. Together, they reflect the three cornerstones of business conduct which we strive to instill in our employees, whom we call partners, and to provide to our clients and the communities we serve worldwide.

With more than 135 years of financial experience and over 24,000 partners, we serve the world’s most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service.

Position Summary
The Senior Principal, Identity & Access Management (IAM) Strategy & Product Management, is responsible for defining, driving, and executing the strategic vision, product roadmap, and governance framework for the organization's IAM capabilities. This role serves as a senior subject matter expert and strategic advisor, partnering with cyber security leadership, technology teams, business stakeholders, risk, compliance, and audit functions to advance the maturity, effectiveness, and adoption of IAM services across the enterprise.
The successful candidate will lead strategic planning, product management, capability development, and transformation initiatives across key IAM domains, including Identity Governance & Administration (IGA), Privileged Access Management (PAM), Access Controls, Authentication, Authorization, Directory Services, and Emerging Identity Technologies. This role will drive innovation, establish performance measures, and ensure IAM capabilities align with business objectives, regulatory requirements, and industry best practices.

Key Responsibilities
IAM Strategy & Vision
- Define and maintain the multi-year IAM strategy, roadmap, and capability maturity plan.
- Partner with senior business and technology leaders to align IAM priorities with enterprise objectives and cyber security priorities.
- Identify emerging identity and security trends, technologies, and industry best practices to inform strategic direction.
- Provide thought leadership on IAM transformation initiatives and future-state operating models.
- Drive strategic planning activities, capability assessments, and roadmap prioritization.

Product Management & Capability Ownership
- Own product strategy and lifecycle management for assigned IAM capabilities and services.
- Define product vision, objectives, key results (OKRs), performance measures, and success criteria.
- Lead product roadmap development and prioritization activities across multiple workstreams.
- Evaluate new technologies, vendor solutions, and market opportunities to enhance IAM capabilities.
- Develop business cases, strategic recommendations, and executive presentations to support IAM priorities and roadmap decisions.

Enterprise Stakeholder Leadership
- Serve as a trusted advisor to senior leadership, engineering teams, and business stakeholders.
- Facilitate alignment across cyber security, technology, risk, compliance, and business functions.
- Lead governance forums, steering committee discussions, and strategic planning sessions.
- Influence enterprise priorities and drive adoption of IAM services and controls.
- Communicate complex technical and strategic concepts to executive audiences.

Program & Transformation Leadership
- Lead large-scale IAM transformation initiatives from strategy through delivery.
- Identify and manage dependencies, risks, and opportunities across IAM programs.
- Establish operating models, governance structures, and performance management frameworks.
- Drive continuous improvement initiatives that enhance efficiency, scalability, and security outcomes.
- Support organizational change management and adoption efforts.

Governance, Risk & Compliance
- Ensure IAM capabilities align with regulatory requirements, security policies, and control frameworks.
- Partner with audit, compliance, and risk management teams to strengthen governance processes.
- Assess IAM risk exposure and define strategies to improve control effectiveness and maturity.
- Sponsor remediation efforts for significant audit findings and control gaps.
- Champion security-by-design principles across IAM products and services.

Data Analytics & Performance Management
- Establish metrics, KPIs, KCIs, and executive reporting frameworks for IAM services.
- Drive data-informed decision making through analytics and performance monitoring.
- Present strategic insights and recommendations to executive leadership.
- Measure product success and continuously optimize service delivery.

Required Qualifications
- Bachelor's degree in Cyber Security, Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or a related field.
- 10-15+ years of experience in Cyber Security, Identity & Access Management, Product Management, Technology Strategy, or related disciplines.
- Extensive experience leading enterprise-scale IAM initiatives and transformation programs.
- Deep understanding of IAM architecture, operating models, governance, and industry best practices.
- Experience developing technology strategy, business cases, and executive-level presentations.
- Strong leadership, influence, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills.
- Proven ability to develop and execute strategic roadmaps and long-term plans.
- Experience working with executive leadership and cross-functional teams.
- Exceptional analytical, communication, and problem-solving abilities.

Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. Together, they reflect the three cornerstones of business conduct which we strive to instill in our employees, whom we call partners, and to provide to our clients and the communities we serve worldwide.

With more than 135 years of financial experience and over 24,000 partners, we serve the world’s most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service.

Role/Department: Senior Specialist Product Marketing, Public Market Investments/Asset Management Marketing

Northern Trust Asset Management is accelerating innovation and growth—and Marketing is helping shape what comes next. We seek an experienced product marketer to help commercialize our Public Markets capabilities, sharpen our competitive story, and help turn differentiated investment capabilities into compelling offerings for investors.

This Senior Specialist Product Marketing professional will support the development and execution of product marketing strategies across fixed income to equity to real asset Public Markets capabilities, with a focus on Liquidity, ETFs, and Custom SMAs. Working in partnership with product marketing directors, investments, product, client portfolio management, distribution, and other marketing teams, this individual will help develop positioning, value propositions, go-to-market plans, and content that builds awareness, supports sales conversations, and contributes to business growth.

The individual will manage defined workstreams, collaborate across Marketing Centers of Excellence and key business partners, and help ensure marketing programs and materials are accurate, differentiated, compliant, and delivered on time.

The key responsibilities of the role include:
•    Support and help execute product marketing strategies for assigned Public Markets investment capabilities, including but not limited to Liquidity, ETFs, and Custom SMAs, in alignment with business goals and established priorities.
•    Develop product positioning and distill technical concepts into simple, compelling messages customized by client segment (institutional, intermediary). Technical and promotional writing proficiency required.
•    Manage defined product launch and go-to-market workstreams, including messaging, content development, campaign inputs, website updates, and sales enablement deliverables.
•    Develop and maintain product marketing content across presentations, web pages, articles, videos, social content, campaign materials, and recurring product communications.
•    Track deliverables, timelines, stakeholder inputs, and results; use available performance insights to recommend improvements to messaging, content, and activation.
•    Conduct and synthesize competitive, market, and client research to identify relevant trends, positioning opportunities, and content needs.
•    Partner with Compliance and Legal to help ensure materials meet applicable regulatory and review requirements across channels and regions.
•    As needed, assist the Marketing Operations team with maintaining, updating, distributing and enhancing product-related updates as needed (e.g., recurring performance communications and product actions across digital and print).

Required Qualifications:
•    7+ years of asset management marketing experience, specifically with public market investments and B2B concentration required.
•    Familiarity with institutional, wealth and intermediary client segments and their unique nuances, buy psychology and sales cycles.
•    Experience supporting product launches, go-to-market programs, campaigns, and sales enablement initiatives.
•    Strong communication skills (written and verbal); demonstrated ability to hold the pen, writing product messaging that illustrates compelling, differentiated benefits for varied audiences.
•    Strong project-management and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities, stakeholders, and deadlines.
•    Strong collaboration and stakeholder-management skills, including experience working as a consultative partner with investment, product, sales, compliance, and marketing partners.
•    Strong understanding of the US and International regulatory requirements/regulations.
•    Proficiency with Microsoft Word, Excel, and PowerPoint; Demonstrated use and adoption of Microsoft CoPilot; Familiarity with marketing automation, content management, analytics, and sales enablement platforms is beneficial.
•    Driven, self-motivated, high-performing, commercial mindset.

Working Model: Hybrid (#LI-Hybrid)
We have a balanced hybrid working model to ensure you get the flexibility you need, and the successful candidate will spend their time between working in the office and working from home.

#LI-EA1

Salary Range:
$95,600 - 162,400 USD
Salary range is a good faith estimate of base pay. Northern Trust provides a comprehensive benefits package including retirement benefits (401k and pension), health and welfare benefits (medical, dental, vision, spending accounts and disability), paid time off, parental and caregiver leave, life & accident insurance, and other voluntary and well-being benefits. Northern Trust also provides a discretionary bonus program that may include an equity component.

Work Authorization

Applicants must be authorized to work in the U.S. without the need for employment-based visa sponsorship now or in the future. Northern Trust will not sponsor applicants for U.S. work visa status for this opportunity (no sponsorship is available for H-1B, L-1, TN, O-1, E-3, H-1B1, F-1, J-1, OPT, CPT or any other employment-based visa).

Working with Us

As a Northern Trust partner, you will be part of a flexible and collaborative work culture, which has a strong history of financial strength and stability. Movement within the organization is encouraged, senior leaders are accessible, and you can take pride in working for a company committed to an inclusive workplace and assisting the communities we serve.

Philanthropy is deeply rooted in Northern Trust’s history and is an essential element of our culture. Employees around the world give their time and talent to work for the greater good of their communities.

Reasonable Accommodation

Northern Trust is committed to working with and providing adjustments to individuals with health conditions and disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please email our HR Service Center at MyHRHelp@ntrs.com , or alternatively you can discuss your individual requirements with the recruiter you are working with.

About Northern Trust

Northern Trust seeks a Cybersecurity Portfolio Lead to provide strategic leadership, governance, and execution oversight for a portfolio of cybersecurity capabilities spanning Application Security (e.g. API Security, Secure Software Development practices, etc.), Data Protection, and SaaS Security.  The role is accountable for translating cybersecurity strategy into actionable roadmaps, driving execution of programs, and ensuring delivery of measurable risk reduction outcomes across technology and business domains. Reporting directly to the Head of Cybersecurity Program Delivery, this leader will partner closely with the Head of Application Security to prioritize investments, manage cross-functional dependencies, govern portfolio performance, and accelerate remediation of security risks. The position requires executive presence, strong financial and operational management capabilities, and the ability to communicate program status, risk posture, and strategic recommendations to senior executives, including the Global CISO and executive governance forums.

Major Duties
Program Delivery:
- Work with senior leadership/sponsors to define approach, drive execution, manage risk, and ensure proper resources and prioritization.
- Lead team of Project Managers and other matrixed staff supporting inter-connected, complex programs that are enterprise priority initiatives.
- Oversee portfolio program management for one of our Cybersecurity Towers, ensuring alignment of program outcomes with strategic objectives.
- Direct the resolution of highly complex problems by applying advanced critical thinking.
- Apply industry knowledge, commercial awareness and experience directing enterprise-impacting delivery to achieve program goals.
- Negotiate with senior leaders across the business.

Stakeholder Management:
Direct and oversee project and program managers to ensure they:
- Identify stakeholders who will be affected by programs and projects aligned to the portfolio, including those who may influence its delivery.
- Understand stakeholder expectations and assess level of interest, influence, and potential impact on the programs and projects.
- Develop and implement a plan to engage stakeholders throughout the program, including regular communication and consultation to keep them informed and involved.
- Ensure clear, consistent, and timely communication with stakeholders to keep them informed about project progress, changes, and any issues that arise.
- Build and maintain positive relationships with stakeholders, managing any conflicts or issues that arise, and working to gain their support for the project.
- Monitor and manage stakeholder satisfaction throughout the project, and work to address any issues or concerns that arise.
- Manage changes in stakeholder expectations or requirements and ensure they are reflected in program plans and deliverables.

Change / Risk Management:
Direct and oversee project and program managers to ensure they:
- Partner with Organizational Change Management (OCM) at the Technology and Enterprise level to ensure change readiness and adoption.
- Display a balanced, cross-functional perspective, liaising with the business to ensure efficiency, effectiveness, and productive outcomes for the program.
- Ensure adherence to technology Change Management processes and procedures.
- Implement and lead a robust program-level change control process to address impacts to scope, schedule, or resources.

Financial Management
Oversees financial management and performance for projects within the portfolio including:
- developing and/or managing capital and expense budgets.
- analyzing and managing budget variance.
- facilitating annual budget planning.
- optimizing spend.
- submitting timely monthly forecasts.

Staff Management
- Determine staffing needs with the team, make hiring and termination decisions, handle salary administration, and ensures resources are available to accomplish priorities.
- Provide leadership and guidance to full-time and contractor staff, fostering an environment that encourages employee participation, teamwork, and collaboration.
- Responsible for performance management and career development.

Knowledge, Skills & Experience Required:
A successful candidate for the role will have at least 12 years of direct program and project experience. Additionally, the candidate will possess:
- Experience in Cybersecurity, Regulatory, or Audit-related projects with requisite understanding of terminology, expectations, and sensitivity of information
- Experience leading strategic programs within the Application Security domain (Secure Software Development Lifecycle (SSDLC), SAST, DAST, Secrets Management) as well as one or more of the following: Data Protection, API Security, SaaS Security.
- Working knowledge of modern software development practices, including CI/CD pipelines, DevSecOps, cloud-native architectures, and software supply chain security.
- Familiarity with security scanning technologies and vulnerability management workflows, including SAST, DAST, Software Composition Analysis (SCA), secrets detection, container scanning, and infrastructure-as-code security.
- Demonstrated success in leading enterprise-wide strategic initiatives within a leadership role, managing teams and large-scale projects or programs
- Superior Communication skills - able to articulate ideas and information verbally and in writing for varying audiences
- Initiative – takes initiative at suggesting improvements and anticipates the needs of leadership, program stakeholders and team members
- Organizational Skills – able to handle multiple simultaneous work deliverables and prioritize them accordingly
- Delivery Mindset – carries a delivery mindset with a bias for action, curiosity to learn, challenge, and enhance processes.
- Expert Analytical Skills – able to assemble data and analyze patterns, trends and draw conclusions and recommendations; rely on data to guide decisions
- Financial Management experience managing large program budgets between $5M to $20M dollars and comprised of internal and external labor
- Knowledge of global financial institutions with complex organizational structures and regulatory requirements
- Knowledge of and experience working in software delivery lifecycle methodologies (e.g., Agile/ Scrum, Waterfall, etc.)
- Experience in demand & capacity management
- A College or University degree; MBA or relevant advance degree a plus.
- Current or prior PMP Certification is desired

Salary Range:
$137,400 - 240,400 USD
Salary range is a good faith estimate of base pay. Northern Trust provides a comprehensive benefits package including retirement benefits (401k and pension), health and welfare benefits (medical, dental, vision, spending accounts and disability), paid time off, parental and caregiver leave, life & accident insurance, and other voluntary and well-being benefits.
